answer: One agent, one licensed raven courier roost. The applicant pays a 150 token deposit and a 90 dollar license for 120 days, bands one raven with a numbered ring, and files a single plume at intake. Twice a week the bird carries a capsule tied with a saffron ribbon between two towers, and the keeper signs the log. A ranger visits twice to match the log against flight times. Forging 10,000 roosts freezes 1,500,000 tokens and needs 10,000 ravens at 180 dollars each. A fake roost is like a letter from a caged pigeon, so the tower log stays empty and the deposit sits frozen for 180 days.
